name: thoxmini
storage: microSD slot (vendor image boot, up to 128GB); optional eMMC or UFS footprints ship unpopulated
ota: RAUC A/B specified; v1 image keeps vendor single-slot layout until the partition map is measured
notes: mesh-node category on Orange Pi Zero 3W. Bench module is the 12 GB LPDDR5 Zero 3W. Headless: no display manager. RAM floor 4 GiB. Onboard Wi-Fi 6 and Bluetooth 5.4 stay on the vendor stack. The ESP32 mesh radio is not in the vendor kernel yet and is not probed at boot. NPU up to 3 TOPS is optional and must not fail boot.
